_comment: Local viam-server config for development on this Mac with a second RealSense D435. No cloud section: reachable only at localhost:8080, no API key (MACHINE_AUTH=none). A cloud-less server cannot fetch registry modules, so the module is a local executable downloaded once with `viam module download --id viam:realsense --platform darwin/arm64` into ~/.viam/packages-local. Fill serial_number from realsense:discovery or the camera label. align_color_depth=true makes the module align depth to the color frame; the operator still records the alignment verdict with rgbd-calibration after an overlay check.
